history.title: Dead Frequency
history.retiredReason: Corpus-integrity correction: the frozen text opened with a three-line `//` provenance header. `//` is NOT Fountain comment syntax (the boneyard is `/* */`, src/lib/fountain.ts:110), so the parser read those lines as ACTION and the metadata was scored as screenplay. v3 is the SAME screenplay with that header moved into a real `/* */` boneyard — not one word of the drama changed. See docs/p1-benchmark/MEASUREMENT_RECEIPTS.md (2026-09-04 corpus-integrity correction) and docs/p1-benchmark/DETECTOR_DEFECTS_2026-08-03.md's dated correction note.
